title.en: Iron Man’s selected angle
title.zh: 钢铁侠的选定角度

paragraphs.en: Tony Stark is Iron Man in the 2012 film’s original six-person team. This edition selects making a rough idea tangible through a small prototype. The cardboard-display setting lets you explore that contribution without measuring engineering, intelligence, wealth or the confidence associated with a fictional inventor. Choosing a model-making response does not prove that you resemble Stark in every scene or that another person should follow your design.
paragraphs.zh: 2012电影初代六人里，托尼·斯塔克是钢铁侠。本版选用小粗样把想法变得可试的角度。纸板展台让你探索这种贡献，不测工程、智力、财富或虚构发明者的自信。选模型回应不证明每场戏都像斯塔克，也不要求别人采用你的设计。

title.en: A moving piece before a grand plan
title.zh: 宏大计划前的可动小部件

paragraphs.en: Friends want a cardboard exhibit to do something interesting, but a long explanation leaves everyone imagining a different mechanism. You fold a rough hinge and invite them to try it. The sample is useful because it makes the question visible, not because an impressive first version settles the design. It can be discarded after teaching the group what does and does not work.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友想纸板展台有趣，长解释却让大家想出不同机关。你折个粗铰链，邀请试。样例有用在把问题摆出来，不在第一版厉害就决定设计。让小组知道什么可行后，它也可以弃用。

title.en: A prototype beside five other contributions
title.zh: 粗样与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Captain America’s angle asks what the group has agreed to make; Thor brings wholehearted enjoyment to the occasion. Hulk leaves room to reset, Black Widow connects relevant information and Hawkeye handles a precise practical detail. Iron Man’s selected contribution supplies something to test. These roles can overlap, and a tied reading does not rank creativity, technical ability or usefulness within a real team.
paragraphs.zh: 美国队长角度问共同约做什么，索尔让活动有投入的乐趣；浩克留复位空间，黑寡妇接相关信息，鹰眼做具体小细节。钢铁侠角度提供能试的东西。角色可重叠，并列不排名创造力、技术或真人团队价值。

title.en: A model needs permission to change
title.zh: 模型要容许被改变

paragraphs.en: An early model should invite revision rather than make the maker its permanent defender. Ask what the others want to test and whether a simpler version would serve them better. Keep costs and effort appropriate to a voluntary hobby. A high count cannot establish impulsivity, arrogance or exceptional intelligence, while a lower count does not mean that you lack imagination or practical ideas.
paragraphs.zh: 早期模型应邀请修改，不让制作者永远守着它。问别人想试什么、简版是否更好，成本投入适合自愿爱好。高计数不确立冲动、傲慢或超常智力，低计数也不表示没想象力或实际点子。

title.en: Try one deliberately unfinished prototype
title.zh: 试一个刻意未完成的粗样

paragraphs.en: For a small optional project, choose one question a paper model could answer. Build only enough to make that question observable, then invite a partner to change one part. Record what the attempt revealed rather than whether the first idea won. This is feedback on a prototype in one setting, not a test of engineering talent or a requirement to build things for other people.
paragraphs.zh: 可选小项目里选一个纸模型能回答的问题，只做到能观察，再邀伙伴改一处。记试验发现什么，不记初稿赢没赢。这是一次模型反馈，不考工程天分，也不要求替别人制作。

title.en: Captain America’s selected angle
title.zh: 美国队长的选定角度

paragraphs.en: Steve Rogers is Captain America in Disney’s account of the 2012 team. The angle here is a clear shared agreement in a voluntary creative activity. It does not measure patriotism, national identity, obedience, military aptitude or moral superiority. A preference for discussing a group’s purpose can coexist with questioning a plan, declining a role or changing an earlier agreement when people’s needs change.
paragraphs.zh: Disney的2012团队介绍里，史蒂夫·罗杰斯是美国队长。本版角度是自愿创作活动中的清楚共同约定，不测爱国、国籍认同、服从、军事潜能或道德高下。喜欢讨论共同目的，也可同时质疑计划、拒绝角色，或在需要变化时改约。

title.en: One exhibit, several reasons to participate
title.zh: 一个展台，不同参与理由

paragraphs.en: A group agrees to make a small display, but one friend wants playful experiments while another wants every participant’s piece represented. You help name the shared outcome before choosing features. The agreement does not require identical motives. It gives the group a fair way to discuss tradeoffs, including a way to say that the project is growing beyond what someone can comfortably offer.
paragraphs.zh: 小组约做展台，一人想趣味试验，一人想每人作品都出现。你帮先说共同成果，再选功能。约定不用动机相同，而是给取舍公平讨论方式，也让人能说项目已超过舒服投入的范围。

title.en: An agreement beside five other contributions
title.zh: 约定与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Iron Man makes a trial piece and Thor gives the activity a sense of occasion. Hulk protects room to pause, Black Widow connects the information people choose to share and Hawkeye completes a specific practical job. Captain America’s selected angle keeps these contributions connected to a purpose people have actually agreed on. It does not grant authority over others or establish a permanent leader.
paragraphs.zh: 钢铁侠做试件，索尔带来活动感；浩克留暂停余地，黑寡妇接上愿分享的信息，鹰眼做具体小事。美国队长角度让贡献连到人们实际同意的目的，不因此获得管理别人的权威，也不永久分派领导。

title.en: A shared promise can be renegotiated
title.zh: 共同承诺可以重新商量

paragraphs.en: Consistency helps only while the agreement remains workable and voluntary. Ask whether people still want the original outcome before treating a change as a failure of commitment. A clear purpose can guide a smaller project as well as a larger one. A high count cannot establish rigidity, virtue or leadership competence; a lower count does not show selfishness or an inability to cooperate.
paragraphs.zh: 一致有用，前提是约定仍可做、自愿。别先把变化当不守承诺，先问还想要原成果吗。清楚目的可指引更小项目。高计数不确立僵化、美德或领导能力，低计数不表示自私、不能合作。

title.en: Try an agreement that allows a no
title.zh: 试一个容许拒绝的约定

paragraphs.en: Before one small group activity, write a sentence about the intended outcome and ask each participant what they can genuinely contribute. Include a clear way to decline or simplify a role. Revisit the agreement after trying it. You are testing whether a shared arrangement helps this activity, not measuring loyalty, civic character or whether you should direct a team in other settings.
paragraphs.zh: 一次小组活动前，用一句话写预期成果，问每人真能贡献什么，写清拒绝或简化角色的办法，试后再看约定。检验的是共同安排是否好用，不测忠诚、公民品格，也不决定其他场合该不该领导。

title.en: Thor’s selected angle
title.zh: 索尔的选定角度

paragraphs.en: Thor is one of the six heroes named in the official 2012 film entry. This edition chooses wholehearted participation and a warm sense of occasion, rather than combat, royalty or supernatural power. You can enjoy celebrating a modest handmade display without being loud, fearless or constantly sociable. The result is an editorial comparison of optional responses, not a claim that you possess a god’s nature or abilities.
paragraphs.zh: 索尔是官方2012电影条目列出的六位之一。本版选投入参与、温暖活动感，不取战斗、王位或超自然力量。欣赏小手工展台不必大声、无惧或总爱社交；结果是可选回应的编辑比较，不称有神的本性或能力。

title.en: A small display deserves a sincere introduction
title.zh: 小展台也值得真诚介绍

paragraphs.en: Friends have made something modest and begin apologising for its size before visitors can try it. You introduce it with warmth and enjoyment, acknowledging the work that actually exists. Celebration need not exaggerate the result or demand that everyone perform excitement. A short, sincere welcome can make participation feel worthwhile while allowing quieter people to engage in their own way.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友做了不大的作品，访客还没试就开始为规模道歉。你温暖愉快地介绍实际作品，看见投入。庆祝不用夸成果，也不要求人人表演兴奋。短而真诚的欢迎能让参与值得，也让安静的人按自己方式加入。

title.en: Enthusiasm beside five other contributions
title.zh: 热情与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Iron Man offers a prototype and Captain America clarifies the group’s purpose. Hulk makes room for a reset, Black Widow connects relevant perspectives and Hawkeye prepares the precise little demonstration. Thor’s selected angle brings wholehearted appreciation to what the group has made. These can support one occasion together without ranking confidence, popularity, courage or how much excitement someone ought to display.
paragraphs.zh: 钢铁侠给粗样，美国队长说共同目的；浩克留重整空间，黑寡妇接相关视角，鹰眼备精确小演示。索尔角度真心欣赏共同作品。可支持同一活动，不评自信、受欢迎、勇气，也不规定该表露多少兴奋。

title.en: Energy should leave room for different tempos
title.zh: 活力要给不同节奏留余地

paragraphs.en: Notice whether your enthusiastic invitation is welcome. Offer a quieter way to participate and let someone watch before joining. The occasion belongs to the group, not to the person presenting it most visibly. A high count does not establish extraversion, recklessness or a need for attention, and a lower count does not mean that you are cold, ungrateful or unable to enjoy shared work.
paragraphs.zh: 留意热情邀请是否受欢迎，给安静参与方式，也容许先看再加入。活动属于小组，不属于最显眼介绍者。高计数不确立外向、冒失或求关注，低计数不表示冷漠、不感激或不享受共同作品。

title.en: Try a welcome with two ways to join
title.zh: 试一个有两种加入方式的欢迎

paragraphs.en: At an optional hobby gathering, introduce one contribution you sincerely appreciate. Offer a hands-on invitation and an equally acceptable chance to watch or talk quietly. Afterwards, ask whether the welcome made participation easier. This gives feedback on one hosting choice; it does not measure charisma, emotional health or your suitability for a public-facing role.
paragraphs.zh: 可选爱好聚会里，介绍一项真心欣赏的贡献；给动手邀请，也给同样可行的旁观、安静交谈机会。之后问欢迎是否让加入更容易。这反馈一次招待选择，不测魅力、情绪健康或公开职位适配。

title.en: Hulk’s selected angle
title.zh: 浩克的选定角度

paragraphs.en: Bruce Banner and Hulk are named together in the official 2012 cast listing. This edition selects a pause-and-reset angle in an ordinary hobby task. It does not reproduce a clinical explanation of the fictional transformation or treat it as a model of real people. The result cannot identify anger problems, dissociation, trauma, physical strength or hidden personalities from a choice about cardboard materials and activity pace.
paragraphs.zh: 官方2012演员名单把布鲁斯·班纳与浩克对应。本版选普通爱好任务中的暂停、重整，不用临床解释虚构变身，也不把它当真人模型。纸板材料、活动节奏的选择不能识别愤怒问题、解离、创伤、体力或隐藏人格。

title.en: A reset before another identical attempt
title.zh: 再作相同尝试前先重整

paragraphs.en: A paper mechanism keeps failing in the same way, and the group starts making faster attempts without learning more. You suggest a stopping point, check what has actually been observed and choose a manageable restart. The pause is part of the activity, not proof that anyone has lost control. People can also decide to leave the model unfinished and enjoy another part of the afternoon.
paragraphs.zh: 纸机关一直同样失灵，小组越试越快，却没新发现。你建议停点，核实际观察，再选可做的重启。暂停是活动一部分，不证明谁失控；也可决定模型暂不完成，享受下午其他部分。

title.en: A reset beside five other contributions
title.zh: 重整与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Iron Man tries another prototype while Captain America revisits the shared purpose. Thor brings sincere enjoyment, Black Widow connects the observations and Hawkeye makes one specific adjustment. Hulk’s selected angle leaves enough space to use those contributions comfortably. It can appear beside any of the other readings without creating a diagnosis or a claim that one person is the group’s emotional problem.
paragraphs.zh: 钢铁侠试另一粗样，美国队长回看目的；索尔带真诚乐趣，黑寡妇接观察，鹰眼作具体调整。浩克角度留舒服使用这些贡献的空间。可与其他读法并存，不成诊断，也不把谁认作小组情绪问题。

title.en: A pause is a choice, not a prescription
title.zh: 暂停是选择，不是处方

paragraphs.en: Ask what a useful reset would look like instead of telling others how they must feel. A short break, a smaller step or a change of activity may suit different people. The quiz cannot prescribe emotional regulation or explain distress. A high count does not establish instability or exceptional calm, and a lower count does not prove that you ignore limits or cannot take care of yourself.
paragraphs.zh: 问怎样重整有用，不指挥别人该有何感受。短休息、小步骤、换活动可能适合不同人。本测验不开情绪调节处方，也不解释痛苦。高计数不确立不稳或格外镇静，低计数不证明忽视界限或不会照顾自己。

title.en: Try one easy stopping point
title.zh: 试一个容易停下的点

paragraphs.en: For a voluntary craft activity, choose a natural point at which to stop, check the materials and ask whether to continue. Make resuming optional and keep the next step small. Notice whether this arrangement helps the task feel manageable. That is feedback on a hobby routine, not evidence about mental health, self-control, resilience or how someone will behave under real danger.
paragraphs.zh: 自愿手作活动里，选自然停点，核材料，问要不要继续；恢复可选，下一步保持小。留意安排是否让任务可做。这是爱好流程反馈，不是心理健康、自控、韧性或真实危险行为的证据。

title.en: Black Widow’s selected angle
title.zh: 黑寡妇的选定角度

paragraphs.en: Natasha Romanoff is Black Widow in the official original-team cast listing. This edition takes a narrow angle on listening across a voluntary group and connecting relevant information with permission. It does not assess deception, attractiveness, gender, espionage, trustworthiness or trauma. A quiet contribution is not a secret identity, and a result does not authorise monitoring, persuading or investigating other people.
paragraphs.zh: 官方初代名单里，娜塔莎·罗曼诺夫是黑寡妇。本版窄取自愿小组中跨人倾听、征同意后接相关信息，不测欺骗、外貌、性别、间谍、可信度或创伤。安静贡献不是秘密身份，结果不授权监看、说服或调查别人。

title.en: A useful detail belongs to its speaker
title.zh: 有用细节仍属于说话者

paragraphs.en: A friend tells you in a side conversation that their display piece needs a different fitting. Before repeating it to everyone, you ask what they want shared and whether they would prefer to explain it directly. Connecting information can help the model work, but usefulness does not erase privacy or ownership. Sometimes the right connection is simply making room for the two people to talk themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 朋友旁聊说展件需要不同配件。你先问愿分享什么、是否想自己解释，再考虑告诉小组。接信息能帮模型运作，但有用不抹掉私密与归属。有时合适连接只是给两人直接聊的空间。

title.en: Connection beside five other contributions
title.zh: 连接与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Iron Man makes an idea testable and Captain America asks how it fits the agreement. Thor welcomes participation, Hulk protects a comfortable reset and Hawkeye handles one exact practical detail. Black Widow’s selected angle helps relevant observations meet without speaking for everyone. These can coexist without ranking empathy, social intelligence or who understands people best. A tied result remains a set of optional readings.
paragraphs.zh: 钢铁侠让点子可试，美国队长问是否合约；索尔欢迎参与，浩克留舒服重整，鹰眼处理精确细节。黑寡妇角度让相关观察相遇，不替人人发言。可共存，不评共情、社交智力或谁最懂人；并列仍为可选读法。

title.en: Do not turn a connection into an assumption
title.zh: 别把连接变成臆断

paragraphs.en: Check whether two remarks really concern the same issue, and let the speakers correct your interpretation. You do not need to infer private motives or smooth over every disagreement. Direct conversation may be clearer than acting as an intermediary. A high count cannot establish manipulativeness or exceptional insight, while a lower count does not mean that you are insensitive or unable to listen.
paragraphs.zh: 核两句话真在谈同一问题吗，让原说者修正理解；不必推私下动机，也不必抹平每个分歧。直接交谈可能比中间传话清楚。高计数不确立操纵或洞察超强，低计数不表示迟钝、不会听。

title.en: Try a permission-based introduction
title.zh: 试一次先问同意的引介

paragraphs.en: In a small optional project, notice one public, task-relevant connection between two contributions. Ask both people whether an introduction would help, then give them room to discuss it directly. Keep private side remarks private unless their speaker chooses otherwise. You are checking one coordination choice, not testing interpersonal perception, persuasion skills or whether you can predict another person’s intentions.
paragraphs.zh: 可选小项目里注意两项贡献间一个公开、与任务有关的连接，问双方引介是否有用，再让直接聊。旁聊私密保留，除非原说者另选。这检验一次协调选择，不考人际感知、说服技能或预测他人意图。

title.en: Hawkeye’s selected angle
title.zh: 鹰眼的选定角度

paragraphs.en: Clint Barton is Hawkeye in Disney’s listing of the 2012 team. This edition selects a specific, useful contribution to a modest handmade project. It does not measure marksmanship, vision, physical coordination, professional skill or whether you are more dependable than others. A small contribution can be freely chosen and visible; it need not make you the permanent helper or the person responsible for everyone’s unfinished work.
paragraphs.zh: Disney的2012团队名单里，克林特·巴顿是鹰眼。本版选小手工作品中具体有用的贡献，不测射术、视力、身体协调、职业技能或比人可靠。小贡献可以自选、可见，不把你永久变帮手，也不让你负责所有人未完工作。

title.en: The label that makes a display usable
title.zh: 让展台能用的那张标签

paragraphs.en: The larger exhibit is ready, but visitors cannot tell which little tab they may touch. You prepare one clear label and test it with a willing participant. The job is modest but observable: can the visitor use the display as intended? You can stop after this task rather than accepting every remaining detail simply because you noticed what was missing.
paragraphs.zh: 大展台备好，访客却不知道哪个纸扣能摸。你备一张清楚标签，邀愿意者试。工作小但可观察：能按预期用吗？做完可停，不必因发现遗漏就接所有剩余细节。

title.en: Precision beside five other contributions
title.zh: 具体贡献与另外五种贡献

paragraphs.en: Iron Man changes the mechanism, Captain America clarifies the shared outcome and Thor appreciates the occasion. Hulk offers a comfortable reset while Black Widow connects information people want shared. Hawkeye’s selected angle completes an exact practical part. None of these readings establishes who matters most, and a close or tied count cannot measure accuracy, competence or the value of quiet work.
paragraphs.zh: 钢铁侠改机关，美国队长说共同成果，索尔欣赏活动；浩克给舒服重整，黑寡妇接愿分享信息。鹰眼角度完成确切实际部分。都不决定谁最重要，近分并列也不测准确、能力或安静工作价值。

title.en: Specific should also mean bounded
title.zh: 具体也应有范围

paragraphs.en: Ask whether the little fix is needed and whether you want to do it before taking it on. A useful detail can be finished without silently expanding into an entire role. Let others choose their own contributions and accept a workable result rather than endlessly refining it. A high count does not establish perfectionism or selflessness, and a lower count does not show carelessness or a lack of practical ability.
paragraphs.zh: 接小修前问是否需要、自己是否愿意。有用细节做完，不悄悄扩成整个职位；让别人选贡献，也容许可用成果而非无限细化。高计数不确立完美主义、无私，低计数不表示粗心或缺实际能力。

title.en: Try one fix with a clear finish
title.zh: 试一件有明确终点的小修

paragraphs.en: Choose one optional detail that would make a hobby project easier to use. Agree what finished means, make the change and ask a willing person to try it. Stop when the agreed check is complete, even if other improvements remain possible. This gives feedback on one practical contribution, not a ranking of precision, a professional aptitude result or an obligation to become everyone’s reliable finisher.
paragraphs.zh: 选一项让爱好作品更好用的可选细节，约完成条件，改好请愿意者试；约定核完就停，即使仍可改其他。这反馈一次实际贡献，不排名精细程度，不测职业潜能，也不要求成为所有人的可靠收尾者。
